notes.title: Windows 10-11 crash fix
notes.content: Fixed a crash when loading a level on Windows 10-11 x64. Nothing special, just a minor compatibility fix for 10-years old game :)

tags.bug: Fixed a crash when loading a level on Windows 10-11 x64.

notes.title: Update to 1.0.6!

tags.bug: - level stat dialog got incorrect data for weapons left, fixed;
- on some machines there were few crashes, fixed;
- game frame rate is limited to 60fps fixing stall issues on 120Hz monitors;
- minor typo, sound and other fixes;

tags.feature: There are also iOS and Android versions of the game available for free.
Main difference is presence of in-game Market where you can buy more spells and amulets.
